messages.content: היי! מה נשמע? איך אפשר לעזור?
שלום דוד! מה נשמע? איך אפשר לעזור היום?
Hello, David. How can I help you today?
Not much, David. Just here and ready to chat. What's on your mind? Want to talk about something in particular or just shoot the breeze?

Sorry about that, David. I think there might have been a misunderstanding. You initially set the language to English, but now you're speaking Hebrew. If you'd like to continue in Hebrew, I can try to respond accordingly. However, please keep in mind that I was initially instructed to respond in English. If you'd like to switch to Hebrew, that's okay, but I want to make sure I'm following your preferences correctly. 

(And if you do want to switch, I'll do my best to respond in natural, spoken Israeli Hebrew from now on.)
